fields.description: Issue includes reports and commentary on Miami municipal finance and opposition to a proposed general sales tax, proposing alternative revenue measures (e.g., theater tax and driver licensing). Articles discuss the economic impact of closing horse-betting "books" and the resulting loss of income and fines, linking the crackdown to unemployment and poverty. Coverage also includes a campaign to reduce traffic accidents in Dade County with statements attributed to Acting Chief of Police W. J. McCarthy, and a feature on the "Most Attractive Working Girl" contest naming Elsie Shope (Mark Store) as a weekly winner. Additional local columns and advertisements appear throughout.
